<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>

<link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.webmanifest">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#18a8f5">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Nuage Nomade">
<link rel="icon" href="./icon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="./icon.svg">

<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" />
<title>Nuage Nomade</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#dff6ff;
    --blue:#1ea7ff;
    --blue2:#0b7ee8;
    --yellow:#ffc928;
    --green:#46cf4d;
    --purple:#7e5bff;
    --orange:#ff9f1f;
    --red:#ff5478;
    --dark:#153457;
    --panel:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
    --panel2:rgba(13,49,98,.72);
    --shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(18,73,122,.18);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  body{
    margin:0;
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, #ffffff 0 8%, transparent 8%),
      linear-gradient(180deg,#bcecff 0%,#eefbff 100%);
    font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
    color:#143456;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  #app{
    width:min(96vw,460px);
    aspect-ratio:9/16;
    position:relative;
    border-radius:28px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8edfff 0%,#dff7ff 100%);
    box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(28,84,139,.26);
  }
  #app{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;user-select:none}
  canvas{
    width:100%;height:100%;display:block;
    background:transparent;
    touch-action:manipulation;
  }
  .overlay{
    position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;z-index:5;
    padding:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;
    text-align:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.1),rgba(255,255,255,.06));
    backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
  }
  .overlay.active{display:flex}
  #home{
    justify-content:flex-start;
    padding:24px 18px 26px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 82% 15%, rgba(255,244,169,.55), transparent 18%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 18% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,.28), transparent 14%),
      linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(150,223,255,.88),rgba(218,246,255,.84));
    backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  }
  #home::before{
    content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 22% 88%, rgba(255,255,255,.38), transparent 20%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 78% 58%, rgba(255,255,255,.24), transparent 16%);
  }
  .title-cloud{
    position:relative;
    width:min(92%,380px);
    padding:18px 16px 20px;
    border-radius:56px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.98),rgba(247,252,255,.94));
    box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(40,126,193,.24), inset 0 -10px 0 rgba(190,231,255,.72);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .title-cloud:before,.title-cloud:after{
    content:"";position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border-radius:50%;
  }
  .title-cloud:before{width:86px;height:86px;left:18px;top:-18px}
  .title-cloud:after{width:66px;height:66px;right:22px;top:-12px}
  .game-title{
    position:relative;z-index:1;line-height:.86;margin:0;
    text-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(8,113,198,.08);
  }
  .game-title .top{display:block;font-size:clamp(38px,10vw,56px);font-weight:1000;color:#1497ef;letter-spacing:-.04em}
  .game-title .bottom{display:block;font-size:clamp(36px,9vw,52px);font-weight:1000;color:#ffbf1c;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(224,132,0,.12)}
  .subtitle{font-weight:900;color:white;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(14,89,160,.35);margin:8px 0 18px}
  #home .subtitle{max-width:330px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.15;margin:10px auto 16px}
  .hero-preview{
    width:min(86%,300px);height:220px;border-radius:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.94),rgba(242,250,255,.82));
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.88);
    box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(18,92,153,.18), inset 0 -10px 0 rgba(194,233,255,.45);
    margin:12px 0 18px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  }
  .hero-preview::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.14));pointer-events:none}
  .hero-preview img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
  .btn{
    border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 22px;min-width:180px;cursor:pointer;
    font-weight:1000;font-size:20px;color:white;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#39c8ff,#0b8ceb 70%,#0a76d9 100%);
    box-shadow:inset 0 5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28), inset 0 -6px 0 rgba(0,74,155,.24), 0 12px 22px rgba(14,90,154,.24);
    margin:7px 0;
  }
  #home .btn{min-width:230px}
  .btn.secondary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#67db66,#43c745 70%,#2fae35 100%)}
  .btn.orange{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffcb3f,#ffa31f 70%,#f3830a 100%)}
  .btn.purple{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#af89ff,#845ff4 70%,#6a48e5 100%)}
  .btn.white{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:#1480da;box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(14,90,154,.15), inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(191,230,255,.8);}
  .tiny-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}
  .tiny-row .btn{min-width:140px;font-size:18px;padding:12px 18px}
  #home .pill{margin-top:6px}
  .pill{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#157fd9;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(14,90,154,.12);
    font-weight:900;
  }
  .hud{
    position:absolute;z-index:4;inset:0 0 auto 0;padding:10px 12px 0;display:none;
  }
  .hud.active{display:block}
  .hud-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 44px;gap:8px;align-items:start}
  .hud-btn{
    width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;
    font-size:21px;font-weight:1000;color:white;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#41cbff,#0f92ea);
    box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(18,96,161,.22), inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  }
  .hud-center{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.76),rgba(248,252,255,.62));
    border-radius:24px;padding:8px 12px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.58);
    box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(20,102,169,.12), inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(210,235,255,.24);
    backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
  }
  .hud-minirow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .level-inline{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:1000;font-size:11px;color:#1f4d77;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .score-chip{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:88px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.84),rgba(244,250,255,.68));color:#147ed7;font-size:18px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.12em;
    box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(20,102,169,.1), inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(210,235,255,.5);
  }
  .bar{height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:#d8efff;overflow:hidden}
  .top-progress{margin-top:7px}
  .bar>span{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd43c,#ff9b1c);width:0%;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,181,27,.35)}
  .hud-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px;font-weight:900;color:#215078;font-size:11px;line-height:1}
  .meta-inline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.56)}
  .meta-inline b{font-size:13px;color:#147ed7}
  .progress-inline{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:#1a5e98;font-weight:1000}
  .panel{
    width:min(94%,395px);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.97),rgba(247,252,255,.92));border-radius:30px;padding:18px 18px 20px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(18,73,122,.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  }
  .panel.dark{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,55,104,.82),rgba(12,41,84,.8));color:white;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
  h2{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:34px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.04em}
  .results-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
  .card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.96),rgba(247,252,255,.9));border-radius:22px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(20,102,169,.1);border:1px solid rgba(232,244,255,.95)}
  .card small{display:block;font-weight:800;color:#5b7594}
  .card strong{display:block;font-size:28px;color:#147ed7}
  .stars{font-size:38px;letter-spacing:2px;margin:6px 0 8px}
  .star-on{color:#ffd12c;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,208,44,.45)}
  .star-off{color:#d8e5ef}
  #levelSelect .panel{width:min(95%,410px);max-height:90%;overflow:auto;padding-right:10px}
  .level-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
  .level-card{
    --card-art:none;
    position:relative;border:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:14px;border-radius:26px;color:white;min-height:235px;
    background:var(--card-art) center center/cover no-repeat;
    box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(20,102,169,.18);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  }
  .level-card::before{
    content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0%,rgba(15,41,74,.06) 18%,rgba(13,32,56,.18) 48%,rgba(8,22,40,.72) 100%);
    z-index:0;
  }
  .level-card::after{
    content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:26px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.26);pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
    box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  }
  .level-card.locked{filter:saturate(.45) brightness(.78)}
  .level-card.locked::before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(90,102,120,.2),rgba(20,30,46,.58));}
  .level-card .badge{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#1a4673;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
  .level-card .card-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;padding-right:6px;padding-bottom:2px}
  .level-card h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:22px;line-height:1.02;max-width:88%;text-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}
  .level-card p{margin:0;font-size:12px;max-width:86%;line-height:1.15;color:rgba(255,255,255,.96);text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
  .mini-stars{margin-top:10px;font-size:19px;display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(10,37,68,.32);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
  .map-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .small-btn{border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
  .toast{
    position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:18px;z-index:6;
    background:rgba(9,57,106,.78);color:white;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;display:none
  }
  .toast.show{display:block}
  .ribbon{
    display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffdf60,#ffb61f);padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;color:#7b4a00;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(230,158,10,.28)
  }

  @media (max-width:430px){
    .hud-btn{width:42px;height:42px}
    .hud-center{padding:7px 10px 8px}
    .score-chip{min-width:76px;font-size:16px;padding:4px 9px}
    .level-inline{font-size:10px}
    .meta-inline{font-size:10px;padding:2px 5px}
    .progress-inline{font-size:11px}
    .level-grid{gap:12px}
    .level-card{min-height:228px;padding:12px;border-radius:24px}
    .level-card h3{font-size:18px;max-width:82%}
    .level-card p{font-size:10px;max-width:82%}
    .level-card .badge{font-size:10px;padding:5px 10px}
    #home .subtitle{font-size:15px;max-width:300px}
    .hero-preview{height:210px;border-radius:28px}
    .mini-stars{font-size:17px;padding:5px 8px}
  }


  /* Premium home screen overrides */
  .home-screen{
    justify-content:flex-start;
    padding:18px 14px 20px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8bd7ff 0%,#d6f5ff 100%);
  }
  .page-ribbon{
    align-self:flex-start;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d5ea4,#083d7b);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;
    padding:11px 20px;font-weight:1000;font-size:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(8,62,123,.25);margin:4px 0 12px 6px;
  }
  .home-shell{
    position:relative;width:min(94%,420px);min-height:760px;border-radius:26px;padding:24px 22px 22px;overflow:hidden;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(65,190,255,.92),rgba(205,242,255,.9));
    box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(30,116,176,.22), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  }
  .home-shell::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 84% 18%, rgba(255,248,168,.85), transparent 13%), radial-gradient(circle at 16% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.42), transparent 18%), radial-gradient(circle at 86% 66%, rgba(255,255,255,.2), transparent 14%);pointer-events:none}
  .home-shell::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:-20px;right:-20px;bottom:-26px;height:170px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 40%, #fff 0 28%, transparent 29%),radial-gradient(circle at 48% 25%, #fff 0 30%, transparent 31%),radial-gradient(circle at 72% 45%, #fff 0 29%, transparent 30%),radial-gradient(circle at 92% 40%, #fff 0 27%, transparent 28%);opacity:.95;pointer-events:none}
  .home-hero-art{
    position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:26px;background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center 24%;filter:saturate(1.06) brightness(1.02);
  }
  .home-hero-art::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(59,182,255,.15),rgba(255,255,255,0) 28%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 62%,rgba(188,235,255,.28) 100%), radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,.0) 25%, rgba(255,255,255,.08) 56%, rgba(255,255,255,.2) 100%);}
  .home-logo-wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:14px 0 260px;}
  .home-logo{line-height:.9;margin:0;text-align:center;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 0 rgba(11,82,153,.75)) drop-shadow(0 12px 24px rgba(11,82,153,.25));}
  .home-logo .top{display:block;font-size:64px;font-weight:1000;color:#fff;-webkit-text-stroke:10px #106fc7;paint-order:stroke fill;letter-spacing:-.05em;}
  .home-logo .bottom{display:block;font-size:74px;font-weight:1000;color:#ffc81a;-webkit-text-stroke:11px #106fc7;paint-order:stroke fill;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin-top:2px;}
  .play-main{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;width:min(86%,290px);margin:0 auto 18px;border:none;border-radius:26px;padding:18px 24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffdf35,#ffc607 68%,#f0a902 100%);color:#0e5da0;font-weight:1000;font-size:32px;box-shadow:inset 0 5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5), inset 0 -6px 0 rgba(196,131,0,.3), 0 12px 18px rgba(19,95,160,.22);}
  .play-triangle{font-size:34px;line-height:1;margin-left:6px;}
  .home-actions{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:18px;margin:10px 0 18px;}
  .icon-action{width:82px;height:82px;border:none;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#36b4ff,#098ae6);box-shadow:inset 0 5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3), inset 0 -6px 0 rgba(3,105,170,.28),0 12px 18px rgba(19,95,160,.18);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-weight:900;gap:2px}
  .icon-action .icon{font-size:26px;line-height:1}
  .icon-action .txt{font-size:12px}
  .score-banner{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(90%,320px);margin:0 auto;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0c5ca5,#0a4b87);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 18px;color:#fff;font-weight:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;font-size:17px;box-shadow:0 12px 18px rgba(10,75,135,.22);}
  .score-banner .label{opacity:.9;letter-spacing:.03em}
  .score-banner #bestEndless{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.08em;min-width:120px;text-align:center}

  /* level select refinements */
  #levelSelect .panel{width:min(95%,430px);padding:18px 16px 22px;}
  .map-header{align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
  .map-header h2{font-size:24px;margin:0}
  .small-btn{white-space:nowrap}
  .level-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;max-height:72vh;overflow:auto;padding-right:4px}
  .level-card{min-height:255px;padding:14px 14px 16px}
  .level-card .badge{top:12px;right:12px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
  .level-card h3{font-size:22px;max-width:78%;margin-top:0}
  .level-card p{font-size:11px;max-width:80%}
  .mini-stars{margin-top:12px}

  @media (max-width:430px){
    .home-shell{min-height:730px;padding:20px 18px 20px}
    .home-logo-wrap{margin-top:10px;margin-bottom:252px}
    .home-logo .top{font-size:56px;-webkit-text-stroke:8px #106fc7;}
    .home-logo .bottom{font-size:64px;-webkit-text-stroke:9px #106fc7;}
    .play-main{width:min(88%,270px);font-size:28px;padding:16px 20px;border-radius:24px}
    .play-triangle{font-size:30px}
    .icon-action{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:20px}
    .score-banner{width:min(92%,300px);font-size:15px;padding:10px 14px}
    .score-banner #bestEndless{font-size:27px;min-width:110px}
    #levelSelect .panel{width:min(95%,420px)}
    .map-header h2{font-size:21px}
    .level-grid{gap:12px;max-height:70vh}
    .level-card{min-height:228px;padding:12px}
    .level-card h3{font-size:18px;max-width:76%}
    .level-card p{font-size:10px;max-width:78%}
    .page-ribbon{font-size:16px;padding:10px 18px}
  }


/* FEATHER_BONUS_SYSTEM_V1 */
.feather-meter{gap:4px!important;min-width:54px;justify-content:center}
.feather-meter .feather-glyph{font-size:14px;line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
.bonus-active-hud{display:none!important;gap:4px!important;padding:2px 6px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.42)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important}
.bonus-active-hud.show{display:inline-flex!important}
.bonus-active-hud img{width:20px;height:20px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.18))}
.bonus-active-hud b{font-size:10px;min-width:20px;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:430px){.feather-meter{min-width:48px}.bonus-active-hud img{width:18px;height:18px}.bonus-active-hud b{font-size:9px}}
/* END_FEATHER_BONUS_SYSTEM_V1 */


/* OPTIONS + EASY MODE */
.home-settings-fab{position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;z-index:8;width:48px;height:48px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(10,92,165,.82);color:#fff;font-size:25px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,64,125,.24);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#optionsScreen .panel{width:min(92%,390px);padding:24px 20px 22px}.option-title{font-size:30px;font-weight:1000;color:#154b78;margin:2px 0 6px}.difficulty-pick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin:20px 0}.difficulty-btn{border:2px solid rgba(39,143,218,.18);border-radius:22px;padding:18px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);color:#1b527b;font-weight:1000;font-size:17px;box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(37,126,184,.12)}.difficulty-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5dc9ff,#168fe6);color:#fff;border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(22,143,230,.3)}.difficulty-desc{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:#4b708e;margin-bottom:14px}.life-hud{display:none}.life-hud.show{display:inline-flex;letter-spacing:1px}.hit-flash{animation:none}

.page-ribbon{display:none !important;}
